source: BMC Infectious Diseases Spatiotemporal Dynamics Cholera DRC 1973-2022
processing_notes: Sources confirm: 'Cases were first reported in 1973 in Kongo Central Province' and 'cases were first imported in September 1977 in Kalemie in Tanganyika Province from Kigoma in Tanzania.' No cholera transmission documented in DRC/Zaire before 1973. Seventh pandemic reached West Africa in 1970-1971 but DRC had no documented cases until 1973 introduction from Angola. Zero-transmission period 1970-1972 validated by absence of any records and academic literature confirming 1973 as first year. Surveillance was limited but introduction year is well-documented.
